Gold.note: Central bank buying and rate cut expectations offset the minor recent pullback.

Silver.note: Recent sharp decline and softening industrial demand weigh on the near-term outlook.

Copper.note: Tight concentrate market and green energy transition offset weak near-term macro data.

Uranium.note: Structural supply deficit and strong nuclear policy tailwinds drive decisive upside.

Lithium.note: Persistent oversupply and slowing EV battery demand growth continue to pressure margins.

Nickel.note: Indonesian supply surplus and weak stainless steel demand cap near-term upside.

Zinc.note: Tight treatment charges and smelter curtailments support prices despite modest demand.

Iron Ore.note: Chinese property sector weakness partially offsets ongoing infrastructure stimulus efforts.

Coal.note: Balanced thermal demand and steady metallurgical volumes keep the market in equilibrium.

Rare Earths.note: Geopolitical supply risks and strategic stockpiling offset currently weak spot pricing.

Manganese.note: Steady global steel production balances against localized South African logistics constraints.

PGM.note: Weak auto production and substitution effects pressure platinum and palladium demand.

Potash.note: Stable global agricultural application rates balance ample Russian and Belarusian supply.

Aluminum.note: Capacity caps in China and rising green energy demand support a bullish structural view.

Diversified.note: Broad basket exposure balances iron ore weakness with underlying copper and gold strength.
